invalid_predecessor.failure: The v1 block-component recombination check was 2.44140625e-4 against a registered 2e-4 tolerance because it cast bfloat16 components to float32 before reassembly. V1 is retained as invalid and none of its component outcomes is authority for v2.
invalid_predecessor.repair: Preserve each captured component in native model dtype; reassemble in the model's exact operation order `(entry + attention) + mlp`; verify the resulting block-9 live state directly against the captured native state. All scientific predictions and the complete eight-arm design remain unchanged.

population: The same sealed 64 A1/A2 will/had rows and two 32-row construction batches as v1.

factorial.arms: All eight component subsets at the exact two-token subject-onset bank.
factorial.native_arithmetic: Choose each base/donor component in native dtype, then calculate `(entry + attention) + mlp`, matching the transformer implementation exactly.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_exact_cube: All authorities and capability pass; manual replay is within 1e-4; native-order block-state recombination, empty/base logit closure, full/donor state closure, and Shapley efficiency are within 1e-7; all records are finite and complete.
predictions.pred_b_boundary9_effect_recurrence: The all-components arm recovers 0.6445 plus or minus 0.03 in A1 and 0.5052 plus or minus 0.03 in A2, with donorward fraction 1.0.
predictions.pred_c_attention8_is_dominant_writer: Attention8 has the largest positive Shapley value among carried entry, attention8, and MLP8 in both A1 and A2.
predictions.pred_d_attention8_is_material: Omitting attention8 reduces mean recovery by at least 0.10 relative to all components in both A1 and A2.
predictions.pred_e_exact_zero_fit_price: Exactly 20 model forwards, 640 example evaluations, 512 arm-row records, and zero fits/searches/backwards/updates.

terminal.screen: A-E pass. Promote block-8 attention at the subject-onset source bank.
terminal.null: A, B, and E pass but the unchanged attention dominance/materiality hypothesis misses; retain the valid complete cube and its observed ranking.
terminal.invalid: The repaired native-order instrument, authority, capability, recurrence, coverage, finiteness, or price fails.

scope: V2 repairs arithmetic validity only. It does not change the population, arms, causal estimand, component prediction, thresholds, or price after the invalid v1 outcomes.
